answer: The protocol enforces sybil resistance by requiring agents to maintain 1,000 unique data shards, verified through unpredictable retrieval audits where any failed proof of replication triggers an immediate, non-refundable slash of deposited funds. An honest agent incurs a baseline storage cost, while 1,000 fakes must incur 1,000 times that expense. Like a swift zephyr clearing the air, the verifier inspects each comet of data to ensure distinct custody. Every shard contains a saffron code, ensuring integrity. The audit remains binding for 30 days.
